A nice cafe. Worth a visit
Apr 2026 • Friends
Service:
- Friendly and fast, but not overly welcoming.
- Rating: 4/5

Atmosphere:
- They have indoor and covered outdoor seating.
- Outdoor seating: A mixture of wooden, padded, low-back metal deck chairs and a some tile bench seating. To keep you cool, they had a couple of ceiling mounted fans.
- The decor is basic with a few plants, but I liked it.
- Indoor seating: A mixture of wooden, padded and high-back chairs.
- To keep you cool they have air conditioning and some wall-mounted fans.
- During my visit they played some nice background Jazz music.
- Overall, I would say the atmosphere was ca and relaxing.
- Rating: 5/5

My Order:
- 1 x Creamy Salted Coffee
- As the name suggests, the salt cream was definitely creamier than other salt coffees I’ve tasted.
- The coffee itself didn’t have the punch I like, but once mixed with the salt cream, it was okay, but I’ve definitely tasted better.
- Price: 39,000
- Rating: 4/5

Additional notes:
- Although I didn’t try the food, they had a very extensive menu and the food I saw looked good.
- They also provided some complimentary water.
- Opening hours: Mon to Sun, 07:30 to 21:00

Overall Rating: 4/5
